name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: load_policy
description: Load and register a company travel policy (simulating PDF document parsing).

max_economy_fare.description: Maximum allowed fare (CNY) for economy class tickets.

max_business_fare.description: Maximum allowed fare (CNY) for business class tickets.

advance_booking_days.description: Minimum days in advance required for booking. Defaults to 3.

max_trip_duration_days.description: Maximum allowed trip duration in days. Defaults to 30.

requires_approval_above.description: Fare threshold (CNY) above which manager approval is mandatory. 0.0 means approval always required. Defaults to 0.0.

approver_roles.description: [Optional] Roles authorized to approve requests, e.g. ['line_manager', 'finance_director'].

notes.description: Additional policy notes or special conditions.

name: search_flights
description: Search and compare flight prices across multiple booking platforms.

origin.description: Departure city or airport code, e.g. 'PEK' or 'Beijing'.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport code, e.g. 'SHA' or 'Shanghai'.

cabin_class.description: Desired cabin class. One of 'economy', 'premium_economy', 'business', 'first'. Defaults to 'economy'.

traveler_name.description: Name of the traveler for this search session.

platforms.description: [Optional] Platforms to query. Subset of ['ctrip', 'fliggy', 'qunar', 'direct']. Defaults to all platforms.

name: get_search_results
description: Retrieve a previous flight search session by ID.

search_id.description: The search session ID returned by search_flights.

name: check_compliance
description: Validate a selected flight option against the company travel policy.

search_id.description: The flight search session containing the selected option.

selected_platform.description: The platform whose offer to validate (e.g. 'ctrip', 'fliggy', 'qunar', 'direct').

booking_date.description: The date the booking is being made ('YYYY-MM-DD'), used to compute advance booking days.

name: submit_approval
description: Submit a travel booking approval request to the designated approver.

search_id.description: The flight search session for the trip.

selected_platform.description: The platform and fare being requested for approval.

requester_name.description: Name of the person submitting the request (may differ from traveler, e.g. an assistant).

business_justification.description: Reason for the trip and any policy exceptions.

approver.description: Name or role of the designated approver.

name: process_approval
description: Process (approve or reject) a pending travel approval request.

approval_id.description: The approval request ID to process.

approver_comment.description: [Optional] Comment or reason from the approver.

name: list_approvals
description: List approval requests, optionally filtered by status or traveler.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by approval status. One of 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled'.

name: book_flight
description: Complete a flight booking after approval has been granted.

approval_id.description: The approved approval request ID to book against.

contact_email.description: Traveler contact email for booking confirmation.

payment_method.description: Payment method to use. Defaults to 'corporate_account'.

special_requests.description: Any special service requests (e.g. meal preference).
